# Karakoram Expeditions Pakistan (LLM Knowledge Base)

> Karakoram Expeditions is a premier government-registered adventure tour operator (DTS License ID-2891, Alpine Club of Pakistan accredited) based in Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan and Islamabad, Pakistan. Specializing in high-altitude trekking, climbing expeditions, helicopter treks, and 4WD wilderness safaris across the Karakoram, Western Himalayas, and Hindukush mountain ranges.

## Core Operations & Head Offices
- **Headquarters**: College Road, Airport Link, Skardu 16100, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
- **Islamabad Office**: Blue Area, Jinnah Avenue, Islamabad 44000, Pakistan
- **North America Liaison**: support.na@karakoramexpeditions.com (+1 415 800 3921)
- **Europe/UK Liaison**: europe@karakoramexpeditions.com (+44 20 7946 0912)
- **24/7 Satellite Emergency Dispatch**: +92 300 9876543
- **Official Website**: https://karakoramexpeditions.com/

## Key Trekking Routes & Pricing (USD)
1. **K2 Base Camp & Gondogoro La Trek**:
   - Duration: 21 Days / 20 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 5,585m (Gondogoro La pass) & 5,150m (K2 Base Camp)
   - Price: $2,850 USD (Early bird $2,450 USD)
   - Route: Islamabad -> Skardu -> Askole -> Paiju -> Urdukas -> Goro II -> Concordia -> K2 Base Camp -> Ali Camp -> Gondogoro La -> Hushe -> Skardu -> Islamabad.

2. **K2 Base Camp Classic (Baltoro Glacier Return)**:
   - Duration: 18 Days / 17 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 5,150m
   - Price: $2,400 USD (Early bird $2,150 USD)
   - Non-technical alternative to Gondogoro La pass, returning via Askole.

3. **Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat Base Camp**:
   - Duration: 8 Days / 7 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 3,967m (Base Camp)
   - Price: $1,250 USD
   - Route: Islamabad -> Chilas -> Raikot Bridge -> Tato -> Fairy Meadows -> Beyal Camp -> Nanga Parbat Base Camp.

4. **Snow Lake & Hispar La Pass Glacier Traverse**:
   - Duration: 22 Days / 21 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 5,151m (Hispar La)
   - Price: $3,100 USD
   - Traverse connecting Baltistan (Askole/Biafo) to Nagar/Hunza (Hispar).

5. **K2 Base Camp VIP Helicopter Trek**:
   - Duration: 10 Days / 9 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 5,150m
   - Price: $5,800 USD
   - Fly-in/Fly-out via Askari Aviation charter directly to Concordia/Paiju.

6. **Rakaposhi & Diran Base Camp (Tagafari)**:
   - Duration: 10 Days / 9 Nights
   - Max Altitude: 3,800m
   - Price: $1,350 USD
   - Moderate scenic trek in Nagar Valley.

## Safety & Evacuation Protocols
- 100% Askari Aviation military helicopter rescue bond arranged for all guests.
- Portable Gamow hyperbaric chambers, pulse oximeters, and medical oxygen on all high-altitude trips.
- Garmin InReach satellite tracking on expedition leaders with live SOS beacon.
- Porter welfare adheres strictly to International Porter Protection Group (IPPG) regulations (max 25kg load, mandatory cold-weather gear, mountain insurance).

## Pakistan Trekking Visa (E-Visa)
- Category: "Trekking & Mountaineering" or "Tourist Visa" via https://visa.nadra.gov.pk/
- We provide: Official Letter of Invitation (LOI), Government Trekking Permit Copy, Tour Operator DTS License Copy, and Day-by-Day Route Itinerary within 24 hours of booking.
